position: Decide the operational shape, not a marketing preference
headline: A provider candidate must pass every safety and operating criterion before credentials exist.
copy: The smallest first slice is a standards-based, read-only Web runtime in one documented region with private access, redacted logging, a spend cap, and one shutdown owner.

postures.title: Runtime
postures.copy: Confirm compatibility with the existing Web Request/Response adapter.

postures.title: Region
postures.copy: Document request, log, and temporary runtime data location.

postures.title: Operations
postures.copy: Name the incident owner, shutdown route, and budget ceiling.

postures.title: Deployment
postures.copy: No endpoint can be activated by this packet.

flow.title: Shape
flow.copy: Require a portable read-only Web runtime.

flow.title: Locate
flow.copy: Document one region and its data boundary.

flow.title: Guard
flow.copy: Require private access, redaction, and spend controls.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Send a complete candidate to founder review only.

decisions.label: Runtime
decisions.reason: Matches the adapter without a provider-specific rewrite.

decisions.label: Write routes
decisions.reason: The first provider slice remains read-only.

decisions.label: Provider
decisions.reason: No vendor is approved by this release.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential has been activated.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Signed test sessions do not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: The queue repository is a reference implementation, not a connected durable store.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Readiness evidence cannot activate invitations or a public service.

packet:
VedaPath Provider & Region Decision Packet
Runtime: standards-based Web Request/Response
Access: private preview required
Region: documented before implementation
Logging: questions, tokens, IPs, referrers, and user agents excluded
Budget: explicit cap and owner alert required
Write routes: 0
Deployment: not activated
Decision: complete the scorecard, then request founder review.
